description: Deliberately restrained motion set. One signature interaction (the status pulse) carries the personality; everything else is quick, functional feedback. Respects prefers-reduced-motion throughout.

signature_interaction.name: status_pulse
signature_interaction.description: The health-status indicator (see ui/icons.json status_icons) softly pulses at a rate tied to severity — a slow 3s breathing glow at NOMINAL, speeding up through DEGRADED and EMERGENCY, freezing solid (no pulse) at ABORT. This is the one place motion directly encodes simulation state rather than decorating the UI, matching the brief's mission-control identity.
signature_interaction.keyframe_property: box-shadow / glow opacity using color_ref from colors.json status tokens
signature_interaction.reduced_motion_fallback: Replace pulse with a static ring of the same status color at 100% opacity — severity is still legible from color/icon alone, just without motion.

explicitly_avoid: Parallax or scroll-triggered reveals — this is a live-data dashboard judges interact with under time pressure, not a scroll narrative.
Bouncy/elastic easing anywhere — undermines the mission-control tone the brief calls for.
Animating more than one panel simultaneously on data refresh — stagger by 40ms per panel max, or it reads as noisy rather than alive.

accessibility.reduced_motion_behavior: Disable component_animations entirely except loading_spinner (functional, not decorative) and metric_value_update (becomes an instant value swap instead of count-up).
